spans.s:
कट् 1. कट् or कण्ट्, cl. 1. P. कटति or
कण्टति, -टितुम्, to go.

कट् 2. कट्, cl. 1. P. कटति, चकाट, कटि-
तुम्, to rain; surround; to encompass, to
cover or screen.

कट, अस्, m. a twist of straw or grass, a straw mat;
a screen of straw; the hip; the hollow above the hip or
the loins; the hip and loins; the temples of an elephant;
a particular throw of the dice in hazard; (at the end of
some compounds) much, excessive (but in the words
अवकट, उत्कट, प्रकट, and सङ्कट considered
as an affix); N. of a Rakṣas; a corpse; a hearse, a
bier, a bed &c. used for conveying a dead body; a
place where dead bodies are burnt or buried, a place
of sepulture; a time or season; excess, superabundance;
the plant Saccharum Sara; an annual plant; grass;
a thin piece of wood, a plank; (अम्), n. (considered
as an affix at the end of compounds), dust of flowers;
(ई), f. long pepper; (अस्, ई, अम्), an agent in any
action.
—कट-खादक, अस्, आ, अम्, eating much,
one who eats voraciously; (अस्), m. a jackal; a crow;
a glass vessel, a tumbler or bowl.
—कट-घोष,
अस्, m., N. of a region in the east of India.
—कट-
नगर, N. of a place in the East.
—कट-पल्लि-
कुञ्चिका, f. a straw hut (?).
—कट-पल्वल, N. of a
place in the East.
—कट-पूतन, अस्, m. a kind of
demon (a Kṣatriya not performing his duties is born
after his death as such a goblin); a kind of Preta or
inhabitant of the lower regions; see पूतना and
अन्धपूतना.
—कट-प्रू, ऊस्, m. a worm; one
who gambles or plays with dice; an epithet of Śiva
or Mahādeva; a Rakṣas, an imp or goblin; a kind
of demi-god, one of the class of Vidyādharas.
—कट-
प्रोथ, अस्, m. the buttocks.
—कट-भङ्ग, अस्,
m. gleaning, plucking or gathering corn with the
hands; the destruction of a prince; royal misfortune,
as deposure, defeat, &c.
—कट-भी, f., N. of several
plants, Cardiospermum Halicacabum (an annual plant);
[]
Clitoria Ternatea = अपराजिता; N. of a tree.
—कट-
मालिनी, f. wine or any vinous liquor.
—कटम्-
भर, अस्, m. the plant Bignonia Indica; another
plant, = कटभी; (आ), f. several plants, Pœderia
Fetida; a medicinal plant, Kaṭukī; a sort of cucum-
ber, Cucumis Madraspatanus; Bœrhavia Diffusa, Ale-
tris Hyacinthoides; hog-weed; a female elephant;
red arsenic.
—कट-व्रण, अस्, m. ‘wounding in the
hips,’ a N. of Bhīma-sena.
—कट-शर्करा, f. a frag-
ment of a mat broken off, or of straw; the plant
Guilandina Bonducella; [cf. कटु-करञ्ज.]
—कट-
स्थल, अम्, n. the hip and loins, an elephant's tem-
ples.
—कटाक्ष (˚ट-अक्˚), अस्, m. a glance or side
look, a leer.
—कटाक्ष-क्षेत्र, N. of a place.
—कटाक्ष-मुष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, caught by a glance.
—कटाक्ष-विशिख, अस्, m. an arrow-like look of
love.
—कटाक्षावेक्षण (˚ष-अव्˚), अम्, n. cast-
ing lewd or amorous glances, ogling.
—कटाग्नि (˚ट-
अग्˚), इस्, m. a fire kept up with dry grass or straw; the
straw placed round a criminal who is to be burnt.

काट काट, अस्, अम्, m. n. (a Prākṛt form fr.
कर्त), Ved. deepness, a hole; (Sāy.) a well.

कटक, अस्, अम्, m. n. a string; a ring placed as
an ornament upon an elephant's tusk; a bracelet of
gold or of shell &c.; a zone; the link of a chain;
a mat; the side or ridge of a hill or mountain; table
land; a circle, a wheel, an army, a camp; a royal
metropolis, a city or town, a village, a house or
dwelling; N. of the capital of Orissa (Cuttack); sea- salt.
कटक कटक. See above.
कटकिन्, ई, m. a mountain.
कटसी, f. a cemetery.
कटायन, अम्, n. the plant Andropogon Muricatus.
कटि, इस्, f. the hip. See below.

कटि कटि, इस्, or कटी, f. (fr. rt. 2. कट् ?), the
hip; the buttocks; an elephant's cheek; (ई), f. long
pepper.
—कटि-कुष्ठ, अम्, n. leprosy of the hip.
—कटि-कूप, अस्, m. the hollow above the hip, the
loins.
—कटि-तट, अम्, n. the loins, the hip.
—कटि-
त्र, अम्, n. anything to protect the hips; a cloth tied
[]
round the loins; a zone; an ornament of small bells
worn round the loins; armour for the hip or loins.
—कटि-देश, अस्, m. the loins.
—कटि-प्रोथ or
कटी-प्रोथ, अस्, m. the buttocks; [cf. कट-प्रोथ.]
—कटि-मालिका, f. a woman's zone.
—कटि-रोहक,
अस्, m. the rider of an elephant who sits upon the
hinder parts of the elephant, as distinct from the
driver or the person sitting upon the loins.
—कटि-
शीर्षक, अस्, m. the hip (as projecting like a head);
the hip and loins or the hollow above the hip.
—कटि-शृङ्खला, f. a girdle of small bells.
—कटि-
सूत्र, अम्, n. a female zone or waistband.

कटिन्, ई, इनी, इ, matted, screened; having hand-
some loins &c.; (ई), m. an elephant.

कटकट कटकट, अस्, m. an epithet of Śiva.
See कटङ्कट.

कटकटा कटकटा, an onomatopoetic word
supposed to represent the noise of rubbing together.

कटकटापय, nom. P. कटकटापयति, -यितुम्,
to rub together, utter a creaking or grating noise.
कटकोल कटकोल, अस्, m. a spitting-vessel.

कटङ्कट कटङ्कट, अस्, m. an epithet of
Śiva or Gaṇeśa; [cf. कटकट, कटाटङ्क.]

कटङ्कटेरी कटङ्कटेरी, f. turmeric; yellow
saunders; [cf. दारु-हरिद्रा.]

कटन कटन, अम्, n. roof or thatch of a
house.

कटम्ब कटम्ब, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt.
2. कट्), a kind of musical instrument; an arrow.

कटम्बरा कटम्बरा, f. a medicinal plant.
See कटु-रोहिणी.
कटाकु कटाकु, उस्, m. a bird.
कटाक्ष कटाक्ष. See under कट above.

कटाटङ्क कटाटङ्क, अस्, m. an epithet of
Śiva. See कटङ्कट.

कटार कटार, अस्, m. a libidinous man, a
lecher.
कट्टार कट्टार, अस्, m. a weapon, a dagger.

कटाह कटाह, अस्, m. (according to the
Schol. m. f. n.), a frying-pan, a boiler or a frying-
vessel of a semispheroidal shape and with handles;
a shallow boiler for oil or butter; a turtle's shell; a
well; a winnowing basket; a hill of earth; hell, the
infernal regions; a young female buffalo whose horns
are just appearing; a dvīpa or division of the known
continent, so called, (perhaps the Katai of the Muham-
medans or China.)
कटाहक, अम्, n. a pan, a pot.
कटिका, f. the hip.

कटीर, अस्, अम्, m. n. the cavity of the loins or the
iliac region; (अस्), m. Mons Veneris; a cave; (अम्),
n. a hip.
कटीरक, अम्, n. the posteriors.

कटिल्लक कटिल्लक, अस्, m. a species of the
balsam apple, Momordica Charantia; [cf. कठिल्लक.]

कटीतल कटीतल, अस्, m. a crooked sword;
a sabre or scymitar; [cf. कडितुल.]

कटु कटु, उस्, उस् or वी, उ (said to be fr. rt.
कट्), pungent, acrid, sharp (one of the six kinds of
flavour); pungent, stimulating (smell); strong-scented,
ill-smelling; bitter, caustic (words); displeasing, dis-
agreeable; fierce, impetuous, hot; envious; (उस्),
m. pungency, acerbity (as a flavour); the plants
Michelia Champaca, Trichosanthes Diœca, camphor,
&c.; (उस्), f. various plants, = कटु-रोहिणी, a medi-
cinal plant; Sinapis Ramosa; (वी), f., N. of a plant;
(उ), n. an improper action, an act which ought not
to have been done; blaming, reviling, scandal.
—क-
टु-कन्द, अस्, अम्, m. n. ginger, the fresh root or
the plant; garlic; the plant Hyperanthera Moringa.
—कटु-करञ्ज, अस्, m. the plant Guilandina
Bonducella.
—कटु-कीट or कटुकीटक, अस्, m.
a gnat or musquito.
—कटु-क्वाण, अस्, m. a spe-
cies of chicken, Parra Jacana or Gœnsis (making a
sharp or piercing noise).
—कटु-ग्रन्थि, इ, n. dried
ginger; the root of long pepper.
—कटु-चातुर्जातक,
अम्, n. an aggregate of four acid substances, as of
cardamoms, the bark and leaves of Laurus Cassia
and of black pepper.
—कटु-च्छद, अस्, m., N. of
a tree with pungent leaves; [cf. तगर.]
—कटु-
ज, अस्, आ, अम्, prepared from acid substances, as a
kind of drink.
—कटु-तिक्तिक, अस्, m. the plants
Gentiana Cherayta and Cannabis Sativa; (आ), f., N.
of a plant.
—कटु-तुण्डिका and कटु-तुण्डी, f., N.
of a plant, = तिक्त-तुण्डी, commonly कटुतराई.
—कटु-तुम्बी, f. a kind of bitter gourd.
—कटु-
त्रय, अम्, n. the aggregate of three black sub-
stances or spices, ginger, black and long pepper.
—कटु-दला, f., N. of a plant, = कर्कटी.
—कटु-
निष्प्लाव, अस्, m. grain not inundated.
—कटु-
पत्त्र, अस्, m. the medicinal plant Oldenlandia
Biflora, and of another plant Sitārjaka.
—कटु-
पत्त्रिका, f., N. of a tree, = कारी.
—कटु-पद्र,
N. of a place.
—कटु-पाक, अस्, आ, अम्, or कटु-
पाकिन्, ई, इनी, इ, producing acrid humors in digestion.
—कटु-फल, अस्, m. a sort of cucumber, Tricho-
santhes Diœca.
—कटु-बदरी, f., N. of a plant and
of a village called from this plant.
—कटु-भङ्ग,
अस्, m. dried ginger.
—कटु-भद्र, अम्, n. dried
ginger, or ginger in general.
—कटु-मञ्जरिका, f.
the plant Achyranthes Aspera.
—कटु-मोद, अम्,
n. a certain perfume.
—कटु-रव, अस्, m. a frog.
—कटु-रोहिणी, f. the medicinal plant Helleborus
Niger.
—कटु-वार्ताकी, f. a variety of Solanum.
—कटु-विपाक, अस्, आ, अम्, producing acrid humors
in digestion.
—कटु-वीजा, f. long pepper.
—कटु-
शृङ्गाल, अम्, n., N. of a vegetable.
—कटु-स्नेह,
अस्, m. the mustard-seed plant, Sinapis Dichotoma.
—कटूत्कट (˚टु-उत्˚), अस्, m. ginger.
—कटूत्-
कटक, अम्, n. dry ginger.
—कट्फल, अस्, m.
(for कटु-फ्˚), a small tree found in the north-west
of Hindūstan, the bark and seeds of which are used
in medicine, and as aromatics; the fruit also is eaten;
the common name is Kāyaphal; (आ), f., N. of several
plants, as of Gmelina Arborea and different kinds of
[]
Solanum, = देवदाली and मृगेर्वारु.
—कट्व्-अङ्ग,
अस्, m. the tree Calosanthes Indica; an epithet of
Dilīpa.

कटुक, अस्, आ, अम्, sharp, pungent, bitter, fierce,
impetuous, hot; (अस्), m. pungency, acerbity; N. of
several plants, Trichosanthes Diœca, a fragrant kind
of grass; gigantic swallow wort, Calotropis Gigantea;
a plant the bark and seed of which have an acrid and
bitter taste, and are used in medicine for worms,
dysentery, &c., Wrigthia Antidysenterica; Sinapis Di-
chotoma or Ramosa; N. of a man; (आ), f., N. of
several plants, = कट्वी and कटु-रोहिणी; Areca Fau-
fel or Catechu; Ruellia Longifolia; (ई), f. = कटु-
रोहिणी; (अम्), n. pungency, acerbity (at the end of
compounds in a bad sense, e. g. दधि-कटुकम्,
bad coagulated milk); a compound of pungent sub-
stances, as black pepper, long pepper, dry ginger.
—क-
टुक-त्रय, अम्, n. an aggregate of three pungent
substances, as black pepper, long pepper, and ginger.
—कटुक-त्व, अम्, n. pungency.
—कटुक-फल,
अम्, n., N. of a perfume prepared from the berries
of the plant Kakkola.
—कटुक-भक्षिन्, ई, m., N.
of a man.
—कटुक-रोहिणी, f. = कटु-रोहिणी.
—क-
टुक-वल्ली, f. = कट्वी.
—कटुकालाबु (˚क-अल्˚), उस्,
m. a kind of bitter gourd, Trichosanthes Diœca.
काटुक काटुक, अम्, n. (fr. कटुक), acidity.
कटुङ्कता कटुङ्कता, f. rough manners.

कटुर कटुर, अम्, n. buttermilk mixed
with water, = तक्र; [cf. कङ्कर, कच्चर, कट्-
वर, कदर, कद्वर.]

कटेरकग्राम कटेरक-ग्राम, अस्, m., N. of
a village.

कटोदक कटोदक, अम्, n. (fr. कट = कर्त
= गर्त ? and उदक), water for a funeral libation,
a funeral rite.
कटोरा कटोरा, f. a shallow cup.

कटोल कटोल, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt.
कट्), a pungent flavour; a man of an inferior and
degraded tribe, a Caṇḍāla, a Pariah, &c.; (अस्, आ, अम्),
pungent.
—कटोल-वीणा, f. a kind of lute played by
the common people or Caṇḍālas.

कट्वर कट्वर, अस्, आ, अम्, despised; (अम्),
n. the skim or whey of curds; buttermilk with
water; a sauce, condiment; [cf. कङ्कर, कच्चर,
कटुर, कदर, कद्वर.]

कट्वाङ्ग कट्वाङ्ग, a wrong reading for
खट्वाङ्ग, q. v.
काट्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. being in a hole.

काटवेम काटवेम, अस्, m., N. of a com-
mentator on Kālidāsa's Śakuntalā.
कट्-फल. See under कटु, p. 196, col. 1.
